tracks.loopNote: loopEnd 0.0 means 'to the end of the file'. The master ends with a musical release that decays from about -18 dBFS at 91.0 s to -38 dBFS at 92.7 s, so the wrap is a decay into the quiet 0.10 s lead-in rather than a click. A tighter seamless loop needs a re-cut MASTER, not a manifest edit: Godot's Ogg Vorbis stream has no loop-end, so loopEnd is honoured for WAV only.
